# Martruther Logistics

> Freight and haulage company based in Harare, Zimbabwe. Runs 15-tonne and
> 30-tonne trucks on routes across Zimbabwe, offering full truckload, part
> loads, same-day and next-day runs, and scheduled contracts.

## Pages

- [Home](https://martruther.example/): Services, the working fleet, the team behind the company, and a quote request form
- [Terms of service](https://martruther.example/terms): Quotes and pricing, booking, collection and delivery, damage and claims, payment, liability, governing law
- [Privacy policy](https://martruther.example/privacy): What personal information is collected, why it is used, retention, sharing, and the rights you can exercise
- [Cookie policy](https://martruther.example/cookies): Cookies and local storage used, third-party requests, how the quote form works, and managing consent

## Services

- Full truckload (FTL)
- Part loads
- Same-day / next-day runs
- Scheduled contracts

## Fleet

- 30 tonne truck - bulk and long-haul, palletized materials
- 15 tonne truck - local and last-mile, smaller commercial loads
- Availability on request beyond the vehicles listed
